name: NIST Risk Management Framework
purpose: The process that ends with an official deciding a federal system may operate.
what: Seven steps and 47 tasks, from Prepare to Monitor, that select controls, assess them and produce the evidence for an authorization to operate.

binds.line: Mandatory for federal agencies, civilian and {{dow}}, under FISMA and OMB Circular A-130.

verifiedBy.line: An assessor tests the controls and an authorizing official accepts the risk, then the system is monitored.

sits.line: Layers 4 and 5. Categorize, Select and Implement sit with the controls; Assess, Authorize and Monitor verify.

sources.title: Risk Management Framework for Information Systems and Organizations: A System Life Cycle Approach for Security and Privacy

verification.note: Read on 14 November 2026: ‘Date Published: December 2018’, final and current, with no Revision 3 or draft listed. The 47 tasks were extracted by script from the PDF’s summary tables and task headings (https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/SpecialPublications/NIST.SP.800-37r2.pdf): Prepare 18, of which 7 at the organization level and 11 at the system level, Categorize 3, Select 6, Implement 2, Assess 6, Authorize 5 and Monitor 7. The Authorize tasks are lettered R. NIST’s reference tool also carries the tasks, but its statement for R-5 repeats R-4’s, so the PDF’s text is used. Read again on 15 November 2026: the page still gives December 2018 with no Revision 3 or draft, and the PDF’s task headings still number 47.

terms.line: A work of the United States government. Lensatic shows NIST’s task identifiers, titles and task statements. NIST prints the titles in capitals; they are in title case here.

related.line: The RMF selects its controls from SP 800-53.
FedRAMP applies the same idea to cloud services that many agencies share.

depth.why: Each task is listed by identifier, title and statement. The outcomes, inputs, outputs, roles and discussions are at the source.

nodes.title: Risk Management Roles
nodes.text: Identify and assign individuals to specific roles associated with security and privacy risk management.

nodes.title: Risk Management Strategy
nodes.text: Establish a risk management strategy for the organization that includes a determination of risk tolerance.

nodes.title: Risk Assessment - organization
nodes.text: Assess organization-wide security and privacy risk and update the risk assessment results on an ongoing basis.

nodes.title: Organizationally-Tailored Control Baselines and Cybersecurity Framework Profiles (optional)
nodes.text: Establish, document, and publish organizationally-tailored control baselines and/or Cybersecurity Framework Profiles.

nodes.title: Common Control Identification
nodes.text: Identify, document, and publish organization-wide common controls that are available for inheritance by organizational systems.

nodes.title: Impact-Level Prioritization (optional)
nodes.text: Prioritize organizational systems with the same impact level.

nodes.title: Continuous Monitoring Strategy - organization
nodes.text: Develop and implement an organization-wide strategy for continuously monitoring control effectiveness.

nodes.title: Mission or Business Focus
nodes.text: Identify the missions, business functions, and mission/business processes that the system is intended to support.

nodes.title: System Stakeholders
nodes.text: Identify stakeholders who have an interest in the design, development, implementation, assessment, operation, maintenance, or disposal of the system.

nodes.title: Asset Identification
nodes.text: Identify assets that require protection.

nodes.title: Authorization Boundary
nodes.text: Determine the authorization boundary of the system.

nodes.title: Information Types
nodes.text: Identify the types of information to be processed, stored, and transmitted by the system.

nodes.title: Information Life Cycle
nodes.text: Identify and understand all stages of the information life cycle for each information type processed, stored, or transmitted by the system.

nodes.title: Risk Assessment - system
nodes.text: Conduct a system-level risk assessment and update the risk assessment results on an ongoing basis.

nodes.title: Requirements Definition
nodes.text: Define the security and privacy requirements for the system and the environment of operation.

nodes.title: Enterprise Architecture
nodes.text: Determine the placement of the system within the enterprise architecture.

nodes.title: Requirements Allocation
nodes.text: Allocate security and privacy requirements to the system and to the environment of operation.

nodes.title: System Registration
nodes.text: Register the system with organizational program or management offices.

nodes.title: System Description
nodes.text: Document the characteristics of the system.

nodes.title: Security Categorization
nodes.text: Categorize the system and document the security categorization results.

nodes.title: Security Categorization Review and Approval
nodes.text: Review and approve the security categorization results and decision.

nodes.title: Control Selection
nodes.text: Select the controls for the system and the environment of operation.

nodes.title: Control Tailoring
nodes.text: Tailor the controls selected for the system and the environment of operation.

nodes.title: Control Allocation
nodes.text: Allocate security and privacy controls to the system and to the environment of operation.

nodes.title: Documentation of Planned Control Implementations
nodes.text: Document the controls for the system and environment of operation in security and privacy plans.

nodes.title: Continuous Monitoring Strategy - system
nodes.text: Develop and implement a system-level strategy for monitoring control effectiveness that is consistent with and supplements the organizational continuous monitoring strategy.

nodes.title: Plan Review and Approval
nodes.text: Review and approve the security and privacy plans for the system and the environment of operation.

nodes.title: Control Implementation
nodes.text: Implement the controls in the security and privacy plans.

nodes.title: Update Control Implementation Information
nodes.text: Document changes to planned control implementations based on the “as-implemented” state of controls.

nodes.title: Assessor Selection
nodes.text: Select the appropriate assessor or assessment team for the type of control assessment to be conducted.

nodes.title: Assessment Plan
nodes.text: Develop, review, and approve plans to assess implemented controls.

nodes.title: Control Assessments
nodes.text: Assess the controls in accordance with the assessment procedures described in assessment plans.

nodes.title: Assessment Reports
nodes.text: Prepare the assessment reports documenting the findings and recommendations from the control assessments.

nodes.title: Remediation Actions
nodes.text: Conduct initial remediation actions on the controls and reassess remediated controls.

nodes.title: Plan of Action and Milestones
nodes.text: Prepare the plan of action and milestones based on the findings and recommendations of the assessment reports.

nodes.title: Authorization Package
nodes.text: Assemble the authorization package and submit the package to the authorizing official for an authorization decision.

nodes.title: Risk Analysis and Determination
nodes.text: Analyze and determine the risk from the operation or use of the system or the provision of common controls.

nodes.title: Risk Response
nodes.text: Identify and implement a preferred course of action in response to the risk determined.

nodes.title: Authorization Decision
nodes.text: Determine if the risk from the operation or use of the information system or the provision or use of common controls is acceptable.

nodes.title: Authorization Reporting
nodes.text: Report the authorization decision and any deficiencies in controls that represent significant security or privacy risk.

nodes.title: System and Environment Changes
nodes.text: Monitor the information system and its environment of operation for changes that impact the security and privacy posture of the system.

nodes.title: Ongoing Assessments
nodes.text: Assess the controls implemented within and inherited by the system in accordance with the continuous monitoring strategy.

nodes.title: Ongoing Risk Response
nodes.text: Respond to risk based on the results of ongoing monitoring activities, risk assessments, and outstanding items in plans of action and milestones.

nodes.title: Authorization Package Updates
nodes.text: Update plans, assessment reports, and plans of action and milestones based on the results of the continuous monitoring process.

nodes.title: Security and Privacy Reporting
nodes.text: Report the security and privacy posture of the system to the authorizing official and other organizational officials on an ongoing basis in accordance with the organizational continuous monitoring strategy.

nodes.title: Ongoing Authorization
nodes.text: Review the security and privacy posture of the system on an ongoing basis to determine whether the risk remains acceptable.

nodes.title: System Disposal
nodes.text: Implement a system disposal strategy and execute required actions when a system is removed from operation.
